scripts.dev: doppler secrets download --no-file --format env-no-quotes > .dev.vars && astro dev
scripts.preview: doppler secrets download --no-file --format env-no-quotes > .dev.vars && astro preview
scripts.secrets:sync:production: doppler secrets download --no-file --format json | jq -c 'with_entries(.value = .value)' | wrangler secret bulk --env production
scripts.secrets:sync:preview: doppler secrets download --no-file --format json | jq -c 'with_entries(.value = .value)' | wrangler secret bulk --env preview
scripts.deploy: bun run secrets:sync:production && astro build && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:survey: bun run secrets:sync:production && SURVEY_ENABLED=true astro build && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:no-survey: bun run secrets:sync:production && SURVEY_ENABLED=false astro build && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:preview: bun run secrets:sync:preview && SURVEY_ENABLED=true astro build && wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.deploy:preview:no-survey: bun run secrets:sync:preview && SURVEY_ENABLED=false astro build && wrangler deploy --env preview
